app.title: llm-windtunnel
app.tagline: A wind tunnel for LLM inference engines

params.pageDesc: A bilingual dictionary of every engine parameter — what it does, its default, its range. The registry behind it also powers the ? tooltips across this tool.
params.archivedEngine: archived engine — parameters frozen at last release

bench.title: Benchmark console
bench.desc: Measure TTFT / ITL / TPOT / throughput on any OpenAI-compatible endpoint — mixed sweeps, prefill, decode and context-length scaling.
bench.modeMixedHint: concurrency × fixed input/output — the standard throughput & latency sweep
bench.modePrefillHint: prompt-processing speed: input-length sweep with a 1-token generation budget → prefill tok/s (like llama-bench pp)
bench.modeDecodeHint: generation speed: tiny prompt + long output (turn on ignore_eos) → decode tok/s per concurrency (like llama-bench tg)
bench.modeContextHint: input-length ladder up to the engine max — TTFT growth curve + the largest working context
bench.modelsLoaded: {{count}} models loaded — open the input to switch
bench.modelsError: Could not reach endpoint / no models — type an id manually
bench.advancedToggle: Advanced parameters — sampling, seed, extra body
bench.advancedHint: Blank / default fields are not sent at all, keeping strict OpenAI-style endpoints happy.
bench.ignoreEosHint: keep generating past EOS until max_tokens (vLLM / llama.cpp)
bench.extraBodyHint: merged into every request — engine-specific fields, e.g. {"top_k":40,"min_p":0.05}
bench.invalidExtraBody: Extra request body is not valid JSON

ttft.name: TTFT
ttft.desc: Time To First Token — from request sent to the first content token arriving. The perceived "instant response" metric; dominated by prefill and queueing.

tpot.name: TPOT
tpot.desc: Time Per Output Token — mean per-token time after the first token, per request. Determines how smooth streaming feels.

itl.name: ITL
itl.desc: Inter-Token Latency — gaps between consecutive tokens, pooled across all requests. Spiky ITL means stuttering streams under load.

e2e.name: E2E latency
e2e.desc: End-to-end request time, from send to the final token.

outputThroughput.name: Output throughput
outputThroughput.desc: Generated tokens per second across all in-flight requests — the system-level decode throughput.

totalTokenThroughput.name: Total token throughput
totalTokenThroughput.desc: Prompt + output tokens per second, matching vllm bench's total_token_throughput for comparability.

prefillThroughput.name: Prefill tok/s
prefillThroughput.desc: Prompt-processing throughput — input tokens processed per second, measured with a 1-token generation budget so TTFT ≈ prefill time. Comparable to llama-bench's pp (prompt processing) numbers.

results.title: Results & comparison
results.desc: Historical runs, side-by-side charts and shareable HTML reports.
results.empty: No benchmark results yet — run one in the Benchmark tab.
results.compareHint: Select up to 4 runs to compare
results.heatmapNeedsConcurrency: The concurrency × percentile heatmap needs a run with at least two concurrency levels.
results.confirmDelete: Delete run {{id}}? The report file will be removed permanently.
